title: Assistant
toggle: Open or close the Nodestro Assistant

welcome.title: How can I help?
welcome.text: Ask me how to use Nodestro, or attach a workflow, agent, tool or run that we look at together. I answer based on the documentation and never change anything myself.
welcome.privacy: Only what you write and explicitly attach is sent. Secrets such as API keys are replaced first.

examples.createWorkflow: How do I create a workflow with two parallel agents?
examples.knowledgeMemory: What is the difference between knowledge and memory?
examples.judge: How does the quality check with a judge work?
examples.testAgent: How do I test my agent without starting the whole workflow?
examples.costs: How can I reduce the cost of my workflows?

composer.placeholder: Ask a question … (Enter sends, Shift+Enter for a new line)
composer.label: Message to the assistant
composer.hint: The assistant can be wrong. Check important details in the linked documentation.

attachments.label: Attached
attachments.refreshed: Context refreshed. It applies from the next message on.

handover.note: Nothing has been changed. You review and start it there yourself.

snapshot.title: Sent: {{name}}
snapshot.text: Exactly this data is what the assistant received for this object. Secrets are already replaced.

picker.title: Attach an object
picker.text: The chosen object goes to the assistant with every message from the next one on, until you remove it.
picker.agentNote: These are the agent templates. To attach an agent from a workflow, use the agent inspector in the editor.
picker.memoryFiles: Include the content of these files (otherwise only the list of files)
picker.includeContentHint: Without this permission the assistant only gets the file's name, description and type.

noProvider: Set up {{provider}} first (the provider of the assistant model) to send questions.
